effect.meridian_vanilla_healing.leg_inju: A wounded leg slows every step; when it can no longer bear weight there is no running and little jumping.
effect.meridian_vanilla_healing.hip_inju: A cracked hip drags at every stride; at its worst, running is out of the question.
effect.meridian_vanilla_healing.arm_inju: A wounded arm has no strength in it: strikes land lighter and digging goes slower when it is the favoured arm.
effect.meridian_vanilla_healing.crippled: The hand cannot close. Whatever is put in it falls.
effect.meridian_vanilla_healing.abdomen_: A wounded belly keeps nothing down for long; hunger comes faster.
effect.meridian_vanilla_healing.short_br: A tight chest and short breath: running costs more and a held breath runs out sooner.
effect.meridian_vanilla_healing.neck_inj: A wounded neck pulls at every effort; both hands work at less than full strength.
effect.meridian_vanilla_healing.dizzines: A heavy blow to the head leaves it swimming; less qi is drawn in with each breath.
